services.name: TrueNAS
services.securityException: TrueNAS HTTPS/API is intentionally published on public port 7000 by pfSense HAProxy, which terminates public TLS and re-encrypts to 172.17.0.24:7000. FastAPI Cloud requires this WAN path and currently has no user-controlled static egress/tunnel; keep the exposure visible as an accepted security exception, require TLS/API authentication, and validate access from approved and untrusted origins separately.

services.name: pfSense
services.securityException: The pfSense administration/API listener on 10443 is trusted-sources-only. FastAPI Cloud is not an approved administration source: direct reachability from that runtime is a negative exposure check and a security-policy failure. Keep administration limited to approved stable sources, use dedicated least-privilege API identities, and move durable posture/Snort telemetry to an out-of-band observer.

services.name: Home
services.securityException: home.albandrieu.com:10443 aliases the pfSense administration/API listener. Only approved stable administration sources should reach it; FastAPI Cloud direct reachability is intentionally treated as a policy failure until a controlled workload identity or out-of-band observer is used.

services.name: Garage
services.securityException: garage.int.albandrieu.com is intentionally published directly through Traefik with Let's Encrypt rather than Cloudflare. Keep this visible as an orange security-debt warning until migrated behind Cloudflare.

services.name: Bichon
services.securityException: Bichon must stay private. Any public DNS or Cloudflare Tunnel entry is configuration drift and must be reported by sickz.

services.name: n8n
services.securityException: n8n currently needs a public webhook path for integrations such as Slack. A broad Cloudflare Access bypass/Everyone policy is intentionally treated as a red security exception; narrow it to the webhook path or replace it with Service Auth.
